title: CoRD: Coupled Rollouts Fill the Blind Spot of On-Policy Distillation
abstract: arXiv:2611.07959v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: On-policy distillation trains a student on its own rollouts, so states the teacher would reach but the student does not are seldom supervised. We introduce CoRD (coupled-rollout distillation), which keeps the on-policy loss and moves only the distribution of training states toward the teacher, drawing rollouts from a geometric interpolation of student and teacher through the maximal coupling of speculative decoding. The coupling keeps the student's token wherever the two distributions agree and otherwise substitutes a token from the part of the target the student underweights, so interventions are as rare as any exact sampler allows and recede as the student learns. Across six base students from two model families (Qwen3 and Qwen3.5, 0.6B to 4B), CoRD raises average pass@1 over on-policy distillation by 0.9 to 2.0 points and pass@8 by 1.2 to 3.4 points on five public math benchmarks at equal steps and data. translated_title: CoRD：耦合采样轨迹填补同策略蒸馏的盲区
translated_abstract: 同策略蒸馏在学生模型自身生成的轨迹（rollout）上进行训练，因此教师模型能够到达而学生模型不会到达的状态很少得到监督。我们提出了 CoRD（耦合轨迹蒸馏，coupled-rollout distillation），它保留同策略损失，仅将训练状态的分布向教师模型推移，通过投机解码的最大耦合从学生与教师分布的几何插值中抽取轨迹。这种耦合在两个分布一致之处保留学生的 token，否则用学生所低估的目标分布部分中的 token 进行替换，因此干预的频率与任何精确采样器所能允许的一样低，并随着学生的学习而逐渐减少。在来自两个模型家族（Qwen3 和 Qwen3.5，0.6B 至 4B）的六个基础学生模型上，在相同的训练步数和数据量下，CoRD 在五个公开数学基准上相比同策略蒸馏将平均 pass@1 提升 0.9 至 2.0 个百分点，pass@8 提升 1.2 至 3.4 个百分点。在冻结的教师可达状态上……
tldr: CoRD 通过投机解码的最大耦合从学生与教师分布的几何插值中抽取训练轨迹，在保留同策略损失的同时把训练状态分布推向教师，从而监督学生自身轨迹覆盖不到的“盲区”状态，并在五个数学基准上较同策略蒸馏平均提升 pass@1 0.9–2.0 分、pass@8 1.2–3.4 分。
en_tdlr: CoRD leverages the maximal coupling of speculative decoding to draw training rollouts from a geometric interpolation of the student and teacher distributions, keeping the on-policy loss while shifting the training-state distribution toward the teacher to fill the blind spot of on-policy distillation, improving pass@1 by 0.9–2.0 and pass@8 by 1.2–3.4 points over on-policy distillation on five math benchmarks.
